passage: The coelacanth is a large, deep-sea fish with fleshy, limb-like fins. Some animals are known to science mainly from fossils. Once thought to have gone extinct millions of years ago, ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

the rediscovery of the coelacanth occurred off the coast of South Africa in 1938.

the coelacanth was rediscovered off the coast of South Africa in 1938.
explanation: The coelacanth is what was thought to be extinct, so it must follow the phrase.

passage: The Sonoran Desert stretches across parts of Arizona, California, and northern Mexico. Deserts differ greatly in how much rain they receive and when. Unlike most deserts, which receive rain only rarely and unpredictably, ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: the Sonoran Desert's rainfall arrives in two distinct seasons each year.
the Sonoran Desert has two distinct rainy seasons each year.
two distinct rainy seasons occur in the Sonoran Desert each year.
there are two distinct rainy seasons in the Sonoran Desert each year.
explanation: The comparison is between deserts, so "the Sonoran Desert" must follow "Unlike most deserts."

rationales.B: Correct. The Sonoran Desert is compared with other deserts.
rationales.C: This compares deserts with rainy seasons.
